The '''Exo-Filter''' is a Utility Mod that purifies debuffs on a Bot Defender and makes them [[Unstoppable]].
[[File:Exo-Filter New.png|thumb|220x220px]]

==Description==
''After an exocomet crashed near Moonbase Two, a series of exo-tech was developed from its ore, including the mysterious Exo-Filter.''

==Max Stats==

* 1-Star
** Health: 238
** Attack: 18
** Rating: 38
* 2-Star
** Health: 496
** Attack: 37
** Rating: 96
* 3-Star
** Health: 3,017
** Attack: 224
** Rating: 563 (level 65)
* 4-Star
** Health: 6,483
** Attack: 480
** Rating: 1,110 (sig 20)

==Abilities==

=== Basic Abilities ===
* Purification
* [[Unstoppable]]

=== Abilities ===
* Every 15 seconds (and at the start of the fight), all Debuffs are purified and an Unstoppable Buff is granted for 2~4 seconds, plus 0.25~0.45 seconds for each Debuff removed in this way.
* Purification immediately activates whenever 3 simultaneous Debuffs are active.

==Strategy==

=== Base Defense ===
You can pair this module with any Bot, especially Bots with their own Unstoppable abilities to make them more Unstoppable often, or with Bots who are likely to be attacked by debuffing opponents due to their Class advantage/disadvantage. 
* [[Megatron (ROTF)]]
* [[Motormaster]]
* [[Tantrum]]
*[[Ramjet]]
*[[Grimlock]]
*[[Thundercracker]]

=== Raids ===
The Exo-Filter is especially effective against Bots who inflict several damaging debuffs at once, and Bots who inflict permanent debuffs. If you must use attacks that inflicts three or more debuffs, do so immediately after a purification activates.

==== Weak Match-ups ====
These Bots' debuffs will not be effective against Exo-Filters because they constantly inflict several or permanent debuffs:
* [[Ironhide (ROTF)|Ironhide]]
* [[Megatron]] (GS)
* [[Rhinox]]
* [[Shockwave]]
* [[Kickback]]
* [[Scorponok]]

==== Strong Match-ups ====
Generally, Bots who don’t rely on debuffs are recommended to use against Bots with Exo-Filters.

* [[Cyclonus]] can nullify the Unstoppable buff if the opponent dashes at him.
* [[Megatron (ROTF)]] relies on impair charges which are actually not debuffs.
